name: conservative
description: Positive valuation gap, available score evidence, dividend signal, balance-sheet resilience, and complete data coverage.

criteriaSummary.label: Positive margin of safety
criteriaSummary.relaxation: Lower the floor in small steps.

criteriaSummary.label: Score availability and strength
criteriaSummary.whyItMatters: Requires a usable composite evidence base.
criteriaSummary.relaxation: Inspect score gaps before lowering the threshold.

criteriaSummary.label: Dividend signal
criteriaSummary.whyItMatters: Highlights income coverage candidates for conservative review.

criteriaSummary.label: Leverage resilience
criteriaSummary.whyItMatters: Flags balance sheets that may be less exposed to financing stress.

criteriaSummary.label: Liquidity and solvency resilience
criteriaSummary.whyItMatters: Keeps distress signals out of the default preset.
criteriaSummary.relaxation: Allow GREY only with explicit review notes.

criteriaSummary.label: Data completeness
criteriaSummary.whyItMatters: Missing provider or internal calculations must be explainable.
criteriaSummary.relaxation: Keep missing-data labels visible when filters are relaxed.

decisionSupportNote: Use these signals to structure research; they do not recommend transactions or position changes in any security.
